verses.english: So It Was Said 78
The Book of the Threes
Chapter Three
Converging Elements
This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Dhātuso, bhikkhave, sattā sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samenti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, sentient beings join together and converge because of an element:

verses.pali: Hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samenti,
verses.english: Those who have inferior convictions join together and converge with those who have inferior convictions.

verses.pali: kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samenti.
verses.english: Those who have good convictions join together and converge with those who have good convictions.

verses.pali: Atītampi, bhikkhave, addhānaṁ dhātusova sattā sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandiṁsu samiṁsu.
verses.english: In the past …

verses.pali: Hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandiṁsu samiṁsu,
kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandiṁsu samiṁsu.
Anāgatampi, bhikkhave, addhānaṁ dhātusova sattā sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandissanti samessanti.
verses.english: In the future …

verses.pali: Hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandissanti samessanti,
kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandissanti samessanti.
Etarahipi, bhikkhave, paccuppannaṁ addhānaṁ dhātusova sattā sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samenti.
verses.english: At present, too, sentient beings join together and converge because of an element.

verses.pali: Hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samenti,
verses.english: Those who have inferior convictions join together and converge with those who have inferior convictions.

verses.pali: kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samentī”ti.
verses.english: Those who have good convictions join together and converge with those who have good convictions.”
The Buddha spoke this matter.
On this it is said:
“Socializing creates a snarl;
they’re cut off by being aloof.
If you’re lost in the middle of a great sea,
and you clamber up on a little log, you’ll sink.
So too, a person who lives well
sinks by relying on a lazy person.
Hence you should avoid such
a lazy person who lacks energy.
Dwell with the noble ones
who are secluded and determined
constantly energetic,
the astute who practice absorption.”

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
